data.one_liner: A dart:io HttpServer wrapper that handles requests from multiple servers.
data.what_it_does: Wraps multiple dart:io HttpServers and forwards methods to all of them. It enables serving the same application on multiple network interfaces with a unified control mechanism, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses.
use_when: You need to serve an app on both IPv4 and IPv6 loopback addresses simultaneously
You want a unified way to control multiple underlying HTTP servers
avoid_when: You only need a single standard HttpServer without multi-interface binding
strengths: Simplifies binding to multiple network interfaces like loopback IPv4 and IPv6
Provides a unified interface that mimics dart:io HttpServer
weaknesses: Limited to wrapping dart:io HttpServer use cases
Not documented for general HTTP client requests
